text:
Update ChatGPT to the latest version and check for Space. If it's enabled for your account, you'll find a shared workspace for pages, files, and collaboration with ChatGPT.

It feels a lot like Notion, with ChatGPT built in.

The pressure is on, Notion.

alt_text: ChatGPT Space welcome screen with a star-filled background and examples of shared documents and designs. The central text reads: Welcome to Space. Your new home to create, share, and collaborate with your team and ChatGPT.
browser_access: Signed in to @LeoGuoLabs; composer accepts text and image.
availability_note: Space requires an enabled account; updating alone is not documented as sufficient.
